title: FUEL L WING TK PUMP LO PR

ewdText: L WING TK PUMP LO PR

announce: ECAM, fuel, left wing tank pump, low pressure.

actions.say: Affected left wing tank pump, off.
Confirm the remaining left tank pump is on and feeding.

status: Status. One left wing tank pump lost; the tank still feeds on the remaining pump or by gravity.
No fuel is trapped; monitor the fuel page and the left engine feed.
Consider the crossfeed if a further pump is lost.
